fetch_recipe: curl -s -o FILE 'https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/api/meeting?issueID=112605261X00319930129&recordPacking=json' with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding; hash the bytes as received.
provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher: first downloaded on 2026-09-30 (UTC) at 21:56:46Z. Downloaded again by this packet at 2026-09-30 22:26:11Z and 2026-09-30 22:59:10Z (UTC), 32 minutes apart, and at 2026-09-30 23:01:08Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第3号 (1993-01-29), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/112605261X00319930129. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Recorded at meeting level because the party-officer identification (the Prime Minister's and a minister's replies to 市川書記長) and the statement naming the chair are in different speeches.

visual_review.method: Diet minutes API JSON decoded and the cited speeches read in full; no page images viewed.

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the House of Representatives Budget Committee on 29 January 1993, 市川雄一, whom the same record identifies as the party's secretary-general (the Prime Minister answers '市川書記長も言われましたように' in speech 25 and a minister '市川書記長にお答えいたします' in speech 43), says '先日、二十五日、我が党の石田委員長の代表質問における借り上げ住宅の提案に対して' (speech 71): a party officer's same-day statement naming 石田 as the party's chair.

locator.speaker: 市川雄一 (71); 宮澤喜一 (25) and 船田元 (43) identify him as 市川書記長

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair (委員長) of 公明党 until its December 1994 division and of the representative (代表) of the 公明党 formed in November 1998, for CLAUDE-C01-31 only, 1990-2026. Convention and other party selections, recommendations, in-office attestations, resignation announcements, predecessor references, acting and interim arrangements (委員長代行 in 1994; the 代表代理 styled 代表 in 2026), other organizations' offices, the organizations' formation, division, merger, renaming and dissolution, and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (an organization event, another office, an acting or interim office). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial offices, parliamentary groups and other parties' offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 公明党, 公明, 公明新党, 新進党, 新党平和, 黎明クラブ, 中道改革連合 or any other party.
